items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of Haushaltshilfe
items.quote: Ihr Widerspruch muss uns innerhalb eines Monats erreichen, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben wurde – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der IKK Mustertal, Handwerkerplatz 3, 57072 Mustertal.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 20.04.2027, sent by an authority (health insurer) by ordinary post, so under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting = Sat 24.04.2027; for social-law letters this day does not shift even though it falls on a weekend. The one-month period under § 84 Abs. 1 SGG starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X) and ends one month later per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, i.e. on Mon 24.05.2027. That day is a business day in NRW, so no further shift applies (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X). The Widerspruch must reach the IKK by this date (to allow postal transit, send it by about 18.05.2027).
